scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend -- --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.vercel-build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm start --prefix backend
